messages.subject: Using theme_set(custom_theme()) centers my chart's title
parts:
Whenever I use
theme_set(custom_ggplot2_theme()) 
my ggplot2 charts get a centered title and subtitle, despite my theme having:
plot.title.position = 'plot' as an argument.

Does anyone know why this happens?

Note: if I just use "+ custom_ggplot2_theme()" at the end of my ggplot2 code, the title renders to the left (correctly).
